stem: What does the graphic best suggest about the different levels of baseball competition?

options.label: F
options.text: More athletes prefer playing college baseball than minor-league baseball.

options.label: G
options.text: Most Little League baseball players participate in multiple sports when they reach high school.

options.label: H
options.text: Playing Little League baseball is necessary to becoming a major-league player.

options.label: J
options.text: Baseball leagues become more selective as players advance.
